workflows.name: Start application autosave after successful Membership submission
workflows.statement: Successful validation, submission and saving of Membership establishes the saved application and starts application autosave. Later successfully submitted portal pages save progress before advancing, using form-next-save. Opening Membership, typing an email or failing validation does not by itself start this business lifecycle. This requirement applies to consumer and advisor-assisted applications; local browser caching is separate from confirmed application saving.
